headline: Casino Director Shot At in Goa
summary: A casino director was targeted in a shooting in Porvorim, with police suspecting business rivalry as the motive. Investigations are currently underway to locate the assailants.

headline: Police Hunt for Casino Shooters as Congress Raises Alarm
summary: Goa Police have launched a search for suspects who opened fire on a casino director. The opposition Congress party has criticized the state government over deteriorating law and order.

headline: Casino Director Escapes Unhurt in Porvorim Shooting
summary: Two armed assailants opened fire at a casino group director in Porvorim. Fortunately, the director escaped the attack without any injuries.

headline: HC Upholds Municipalities Ordinance, Sets Election Deadline
summary: The Bombay High Court has upheld the Goa Municipalities Ordinance. The court has directed that the local body elections must be conducted by January 2.

headline: HC Rules Government Cannot Delay Elections for Convenience
summary: The Bombay High Court stated that no government can choose politically convenient dates for elections. The court has established a strict timeline for 11 municipal bodies.

headline: SEC Begins Delimitation for 11 Municipalities
summary: The State Election Commission of Goa has initiated the final ward delimitation process. This step comes ahead of elections for 11 municipal councils.

headline: Cabinet Clears Anti-Conversion Bill with Strict Penalties
summary: The Goa cabinet has approved a draft anti-conversion bill. The proposed legislation includes life imprisonment and heavy fines for violators.

headline: Goa Cabinet Approves Anti-Conversion Bill for Assembly
summary: An anti-conversion bill has been cleared by the Goa cabinet. The bill is set to be officially tabled in the upcoming Assembly session.

headline: Church Groups Protest Against Proposed Anti-Conversion Bill
summary: Various church groups in Goa have strongly opposed the state's proposed anti-conversion legislation. Critics argue the bill is unnecessary and target-driven.

headline: Health Minister Initiates Surprise Inspections
summary: Goa's Health Minister has taken swift action by conducting strict, surprise inspections at public facilities. This move aims to improve accountability and service standards.

headline: FDA Shuts Down Three Government Canteens
summary: The Food and Drugs Administration has ordered the closure of three government canteens in Goa. The action was taken due to structural defects and poor kitchen hygiene.

headline: Three Government Canteens Ordered to Stop Operations
summary: Following hygiene and safety inspections, three government-run canteens in Goa have been suspended. The facilities must address safety and cleanliness issues before resuming.

headline: Goa Records 61.38 Lakh Tourists in Seven Months
summary: Over 61 lakh tourists visited Goa during a seven-month period, marking a significant recovery. International charter flight bookings have also seen a steady rise.

headline: Supreme Court Directs Regularisation of PWD Workers
summary: The Supreme Court has ruled in favour of long-serving Goa PWD workers, allowing their regularisation. The apex court emphasized that the state cannot exploit temporary labour.

headline: Criticism Mounts Over Drug-Free School Zone Rule
summary: The Goa government's directive to establish a 500-metre drug-free zone around schools has faced heavy criticism. Detractors have mocked the arbitrary distance limit.

headline: Catholics Alarmed by Goa’s Proposed Anti-Conversion Law
summary: The Catholic community in Goa has expressed serious concern over the planned anti-conversion bill. Church members fear the law could be misused against minorities.

headline: Goa AAP MLA Discusses Mhadei Issue with Karnataka Chief
summary: An AAP MLA from Goa met with Karnataka's Water Resources Department chief. The meeting was held to address ongoing concerns regarding the Mhadei river diversion.

headline: Goa EDC Records Rs 128 Crore in Revenue
summary: The Goa Economic Development Corporation has achieved a revenue of Rs 128 crore. The corporation continues to actively support local entrepreneurs.

headline: Unidentified Gunmen Open Fire Near Porvorim Casino
summary: Panic struck Porvorim as unidentified shooters opened fire targeting a casino. Police have cordoned off the area and are reviewing security footage.

headline: RGP MLA Slams BJP Government After Porvorim Shootout
summary: Revolutionary Goans Party MLA has launched a scathing attack on the ruling BJP government. The lawmaker cited the recent Porvorim shooting as a failure of law and order.

headline: Winter Bookings Surge as Goa Welcomes 61 Lakh Tourists
summary: Goa has seen an influx of 61 lakh visitors in just seven months. Local operators expect a highly successful winter season as bookings continue to rise.

headline: CCTV Captures Attackers Fleeing After Casino Shootout
summary: Security cameras captured the moment gunmen fled the scene after firing at a casino director. The victim managed to escape the attack completely unharmed.

headline: Three Arrested for Fatal Mob Lynching in Nuvem
summary: Goa Police have arrested three individuals in connection with a lynching in Nuvem. The victim was allegedly beaten to death over suspicions of theft.

headline: Huge Liquor Cache Seized at Patradevi Border
summary: Officials seized 400 boxes of illegal liquor hidden beneath onions and potatoes at the Patradevi border checkpost. The contraband was being smuggled out of the state.

headline: Actor Armaan Jain Shares His Love for Goa
summary: Bollywood actor Armaan Jain spoke about his personal connection to Goa. He highlighted his fondness for the local cuisine, films, and the coastal lifestyle.

headline: Manhunt On for Gunmen Who Targeted Casino Executive
summary: Law enforcement agencies have launched a massive manhunt for two suspects who fired at a casino executive. The opposition continues to demand stronger action on safety.

headline: Rupali Ganguly Expresses Her Preference for Goa Holidays
summary: TV actress Rupali Ganguly shared that she prefers vacationing in Goa over international destinations like the Maldives. She praised India's domestic tourism offerings.

headline: Photography Exhibition Showcases 20-Year-Old Portraits
summary: A new exhibition in Goa is featuring a photographer's collection of two-decade-old portraits. The photos capture nostalgic glimpses of everyday Goan life.

headline: Shootout Near Police Headquarters Shocks Panaji
summary: Residents were left shocked after a brazen shootout occurred near the North Goa Police Headquarters. The suspects remain at large as police intensify search operations.

headline: Congress Criticizes Law and Order After Casino Shooting
summary: Following a targeted attack on a casino director, the Congress party has accused the government of failing to maintain public safety. Police are still tracking the shooters.

headline: Opposition Mocks Government’s 500m Drug-Free School Zone
summary: Opposition leaders have slammed the Goa government's circular regarding drug-free zones around schools. Critics questioned the safety of students just outside the 500-metre boundary.

headline: Relief Granted to Unauthorised Coastal Structures
summary: The government has provided major relief to unauthorized structures located in Coastal Regulation Zone areas. The decision helps prevent immediate demolition drives.

headline: Casino Director Escapes Uninjured in Gun Attack
summary: Gunmen opened fire on a Goa casino director in a shocking outdoor attack. The director managed to escape without suffering any physical injuries.

headline: Two Hit-and-Run Victims Receive Official Compensation
summary: Financial compensation has been handed over to two victims of hit-and-run incidents in Goa. The relief funds were sanctioned under state welfare schemes.

headline: Goa University Adds AI Elective to Postgrad Courses
summary: Goa University has introduced artificial intelligence as an elective course for all postgraduate programs. The move aims to equip students with modern technology skills.

headline: Gatherings Prohibited in Panaji Ahead of Assembly Session
summary: District authorities have banned public gatherings in Panaji and Porvorim. The restriction has been imposed ahead of the state legislative assembly session.

headline: Three Vehicles Destroyed in Navelim Fire
summary: A sudden fire in Navelim completely gutted three vehicles parked close to each other. Fire services responded quickly to prevent the flames from spreading further.

headline: Devotees Celebrate Narali Poornima in Goa
summary: Traditional fishermen and devotees offered coconuts to the sea deities on Narali Poornima. The ritual is performed to pray for safe fishing voyages and prosperity.

headline: Goa University Upgrades Infrastructure with Central Funds
summary: Goa University has constructed a 500-seater auditorium, hostels, and a futsal court using Rs 100 crore under the PM-Usha scheme. These additions will boost campus life.

headline: Catholic Association Labels Anti-Conversion Bill a Stunt
summary: The Goa Catholic Association has termed the state's proposed anti-conversion bill as an election gimmick. The group urged the government to focus on real issues.

headline: Loan Exit Scheme Launched for Failed Businesses
summary: The Goa government has introduced a special loan exit scheme to help struggling entrepreneurs. The initiative aims to provide relief to businesses unable to repay state loans.

headline: Lords Hotels & Resorts to Launch Premium Goa Property
summary: Lords Hotels & Resorts has announced the upcoming opening of a new premium leisure property in Goa. The resort will cater to the rising influx of leisure travelers.

headline: CAD Board Defers Dhargalim Denotification Process
summary: The Tillari Command Area Development board has postponed the denotification of Dhargalim. The decision was delayed due to incomplete documentation submitted by officials.

headline: Goan NRI Woman Missing in Nepal Flash Floods
summary: Search efforts are underway for a Goan NRI woman who went missing during severe flash floods in Nepal. Her family is awaiting updates from local rescue teams.

headline: Cabinet Approves Anti-Conversion Bill with Life Imprisonment
summary: The Goa cabinet has cleared an anti-conversion bill that proposes life imprisonment for offenders. The draft legislation will be presented in the legislature soon.

headline: CM Pramod Sawant Promises Strict Action After Shootout
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has condemned the recent shootout in Porvorim, stating such violence will not be tolerated. He assured the public of strict action against the culprits.

headline: Shooting in Porvorim Targets Casino Director and Guard
summary: Two armed assailants shot at a casino director and his security guard in Porvorim. Both individuals managed to escape the attack without sustaining any injuries.

headline: International Charter Bookings Drive Goa Tourism Surge
summary: Goa welcomed over 61 lakh visitors in the first seven months of the year, boosted by a rise in international charter bookings. Tourism stakeholders expect a busy winter season.

headline: Goa Police Bill Revived Prior to Assembly Session
summary: The state government has revived the pending Goa Police Bill just ahead of the legislative assembly session. The bill proposes significant reforms to law enforcement.

headline: Armed Assailants Open Fire at Casino Director in Porvorim
summary: Two gunmen targeted a casino director and his security guard in Porvorim. Police are investigating the shootout and hunting for the missing attackers.
